"true" -> Bool(b: true) | true
"42" -> Int(n: 42) | 42
"-7" -> Int(n: -7) | -7

"1.5" -> Num(n: 1.5) | 1.5
"1e3" -> Num(n: 1000.0) | 1000
"-0.0" -> Num(n: -0.0) | -0
"\"a\\u00e9\\n\\ud83d\\ude00\"" -> Str(s: "aé\n😀") | "aé\n😀"
"[]" -> List(items: []) | []

"{\"x\":{\"y\":[true,null]}}" -> Object(fields: [("x", Object(fields: [("y", List(items: [Bool(b: true), Null]))]))]) | {"x":{"y":[true,null]}}
